lines.trans: Do you have any news from Colette?
I messed up, I let her leave.
We were destined for this evening.
I would do anything for my actors.
But you neglect your own family?
When Colette calls me, I do not come home.
It should be totally the reverse.
Maybe my brain is wired wrong.
You know what? Let us make a pact!

words.gram: interrogative pronoun in tu sais quoi

lines.trans: What kind of serious pact?
We are going to take our lives back in hand.
And we stop impulsive decisions?
Exactly, except for these delicious profiteroles!
These profiteroles were an absolute emergency!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il arrête de travailler à six heures.
Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: C'est mauvais pour les jeunes cerveaux.

meanings.note: avoir le cerveau mal câblé = to be wired wrong

examples.text: Ils ont câblé tout le studio.
La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
also as an answer: Exactement! = That's right!
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.text: C'est pour faire plaisir à ma famille.
examples.trans: It's to make my family happy.

examples.text: Vous n'êtes pas du genre mélancolique.

meanings.note: être du genre... = to be the type to...

examples.trans: It is the opposite of what I wanted.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Elle a un stylo à la main.
examples.trans: She has a pen in her hand.

examples.text: Je ne veux pas te faire de mal.
examples.trans: I don't want to hurt you.

meanings.note: faire du mal à quelqu'un = to hurt someone
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille

meanings.en: to mess up, screw up, foul up

examples.trans: I messed up, I let her leave.

examples.text: Le moteur a merdé pendant la course.
examples.trans: The engine messed up during the race.

meanings.note: dire n'importe quoi = to talk nonsense
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.trans: Do not neglect any detail of the contract.

to take back, to have more of
